wdauto

wdauto prepares and starts the local WebDriver service used by tidypptsdd to download reports through Chrome or Edge. It runs on x86 and x64 Windows with R 4.1 or newer and the selected browser installed. Chrome runs through ChromeDriver with backend = "chromedriver" (no Java needed, used by tidypptsdd), or through Selenium Server 3.141.59 on Java for RSelenium clients (the default). Edge uses Microsoft Edge WebDriver directly.

Get started · 中文使用说明 · Cheatsheet · 速查表

Installation 

install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("tony2015116/wdauto")

Start or reuse Chrome 

library(wdauto)

driver_dir <- "C:/webdriver"
get_cd(driver_dir)
get_ss(driver_dir)
auto_cs(driver_dir)

get_cd() matches the installed Chrome milestone and Windows platform and reuses a cached driver without network access. get_ss() prepares the Selenium 3.141.59 standalone server, which accepts the legacy JSON Wire protocol used by RSelenium. auto_cs() waits for the service at 127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub to accept connections. Repeated calls reuse the running managed service.

Clients that speak the W3C protocol can skip Java and Selenium:

get_cd(driver_dir)
auto_cs(driver_dir, backend = "chromedriver")

ChromeDriver then serves the same address, 127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub.

Start or reuse Edge 

get_cd(driver_dir, browser = "edge")
auto_cs(driver_dir, browser = "edge")

Edge uses a separate service at 127.0.0.1:4445 and its own login startup entry. Select Edge in both the startup and download calls in tidypptsdd.

Downloads in mainland China or offline

Driver and Selenium downloads try a mirror first and fall back to the official servers:

options(wdauto.mirror = "npmmirror")   # or Sys.setenv(WDAUTO_MIRROR = "npmmirror")
get_cd(driver_dir)

Any other mirror can be given as URL prefix replacements, for example options(wdauto.mirror = c("https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public" = "https://my.mirror/cft")). The option in effect when auto_cs() writes the startup entry is reused at login. Without network access, install archives that were downloaded on another computer:

get_cd(driver_dir, zip = "chromedriver-win64.zip")
get_ss(driver_dir, jar = "selenium-server-standalone-3.141.59.jar")

Login startup and browser updates

By default auto_cs() installs or updates a hidden login startup entry (wdauto_chrome.vbs or wdauto_edge.vbs in the current user’s Startup folder). Pass autostart = FALSE for a one-time start. At login the driver is resolved again and the start is retried for about two minutes while the network comes up. Entries written by earlier wdauto releases are replaced.

When the browser updates while the service is running, the next auto_cs() call restarts the service with the new driver if no session is open. Pass restart = "never" to get an error instead.

Stop or troubleshoot the service

Run reset_cs() to stop the managed service and remove its login startup entry for Chrome. For Edge, use reset_cs(browser = "edge"). reset_cs() still removes the startup entry when the process record is damaged.

The service logs are in %LOCALAPPDATA%/wdauto/webdriver-*/; the five newest are kept. The login launcher writes to %LOCALAPPDATA%/wdauto/startup.log for Chrome, or to %LOCALAPPDATA%/wdauto/edge/startup.log for Edge. If port 4444 is already in use after upgrading from an older version, stop the previous Selenium process before starting the new one.
